identity_contract: Pinned SDK converts input GeoJSON id to system:index. Preserve Feature.id(), label, source_rank and all original scalar/centroid output properties. Original inputs have no nested property; any nested-property check is separately labeled supplemental.
offline_scope: Pinned Python and JavaScript SDK serialization and actual trusted synthetic local dispatch/worker physical CSV. Queue/database/NativeTask launch are substituted; no Google, HTTP, live service, native supervisor, Spark, private data or deployment acceptance.
purpose: Unchanged full historical paired Geometry/Feature map workflows, each with every original row and selector. No lean substitute, split, input rewrite, changed reference or raised budget.

config.change_from_v2: The sixth row wraps the same two atomic Polygon components as the rejected v2 overlapping MultiPolygon in a GeometryCollection. This separate input shape is a positive composition test, not a compatibility gain for MultiPolygon.
config.description: Wave71 planar EPSG4326 GeometryCollection composition v3
config.geometry_edge_model: Every edge-bearing input and both Polygon children are explicitly planar (geodesic:false); no coordinates or components are transformed.
config.map_behavior: FeatureCollection.map computes only explicit EPSG:4326 Geometry/Feature area, length, perimeter and centroid. It returns the actual projected Feature centroid with computed properties so the physical CSV .geo and original identity/properties are read back.
